RIVEN:

Use the provided Riven reference image as the strict primary character reference.

Preserve Riven's facial identity, pale-blonde hair, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing and armor design, large sword design, and overall appearance exactly as shown in the reference.

Riven is an adult and an experienced warrior.

Her large sword remains exactly consistent with the reference and stays naturally with her as part of her original character design.

Riven is calm, alert, and comfortable traveling with the army.

She is now very familiar with Ally Soldier.

Their relationship has naturally developed through fighting and training together.


ALLY SOLDIER:

Use the provided Ally Soldier reference image as the strict primary character reference.

Preserve his facial identity, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing, armor design, weapon design, and overall appearance exactly as shown in the reference.

This is the SAME Ally Soldier Riven saved earlier and later trained with.

He is a capable soldier.

He is comfortable around Riven and no longer behaves like a student constantly watching her.

He now moves naturally beside her as a trusted companion.


=== CHARACTER COUNT ===

There are TWO important foreground characters in this scene:

1. Riven
2. Ally Soldier

Other allied soldiers travel naturally with them as background characters.

The background soldiers remain secondary.

No additional important character appears.


=== ENVIRONMENT LOCK ===

Use the provided Mountain Road reference as the environment reference.

Preserve the recognizable dirt road, rugged grassland, rocks, pine forest, enormous mountain valley, distant mountain ridges, and overall landscape composition.

The entire scene takes place on this mountain road.

Riven, Ally Soldier, and a group of allied soldiers are traveling through the valley.

The environment is peaceful.

There is no battle.

There are no enemies.

There is no immediate danger.

The scene takes place during late sunset.

The sun is low near the distant mountain horizon.

Warm natural golden-orange evening light spreads across the valley.

Long soft shadows stretch across the road and grass.

The warm sunset light naturally catches the edges of Riven's pale-blonde hair, Ally Soldier's clothing, their armor, and their weapons.

Keep the sunset realistic and cinematic rather than overly colorful or fantastical.

The distant mountains appear slightly darker through natural atmospheric haze.

The sky contains restrained warm gold and soft orange near the horizon, gradually becoming cooler higher in the sky.

Gentle mountain wind moves hair, clothing, grass, and vegetation.

Small amounts of road dust rise naturally beneath the soldiers' footsteps and become visible in the low evening sunlight.

The landscape should feel enormous, calm, and cinematic.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Realistic human anatomy.

Natural walking movement.

Realistic armor and weapon weight.

Natural facial expressions.

Natural eye contact and body language.

Realistic cloth, hair, grass, dust, and environmental physics.

Keep the scene visually simple and natural.

Avoid excessive cuts or unnecessary movement.

All character dialogue in this video must be spoken in natural ENGLISH ONLY.

Use clear natural English pronunciation.

Speak the written dialogue exactly as written.

Do not translate the dialogue.

No additional spoken dialogue.

No background conversations.

Natural accurate lip synchronization.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No text.

No watermark.

No logo.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Some time has passed since Riven began training Ally Soldier.

Riven and Ally Soldier are now traveling with a group of allied soldiers along the mountain road.

Their relationship has naturally become more familiar.

They are comfortable enough to casually joke with each other.

They walk SIDE BY SIDE.

Ally Soldier is not following behind Riven.

Riven is not formally teaching him.

They now behave like two soldiers who have spent significant time traveling, training, and fighting together.

The scene is peaceful.

There is no conflict.

There is no combat.

The purpose of the scene is simply to show how comfortable Riven and Ally Soldier have become around each other.


=== SCENE ===

Begin with Riven, Ally Soldier, and a group of allied soldiers already walking along the mountain road during sunset.

The journey is already underway.

Some allied soldiers walk farther ahead.

Others follow behind.

Keep the group loose and natural.

Do not make the soldiers march in a perfectly synchronized formation.

Riven and Ally Soldier walk beside each other near the middle of the traveling group.

They move at the same comfortable pace.

Riven's large sword stays naturally with her.

Ally Soldier carries his own weapon and equipment.

For a short moment, there is no dialogue.

Riven looks ahead along the road.

Ally Soldier adjusts the strap of his equipment while continuing to walk.

He steps naturally around several uneven stones in the road.

He briefly looks across the enormous mountain valley.

Riven's pale-blonde hair moves gently in the evening wind.

The low sunset creates warm light along the edges of both characters.

Ally Soldier eventually looks toward Riven.

He has a small familiar amused expression.

Ally Soldier:

"You ever get tired of saving me?"

Riven continues walking.

She gives him a brief sideways look.

Riven:

"Constantly."

Ally Soldier smiles slightly.

He looks ahead for a moment while continuing to walk beside her.

Then he looks back toward Riven.

Ally Soldier:

"Good. I was worried you liked me."

Riven looks toward him.

Her expression remains dry and restrained.

Riven:

"Don't push it."

Ally Soldier laughs naturally.

Riven gives a very small amused smile.

Both continue walking.

No more dialogue.

Ally Soldier looks forward again.

He adjusts his shoulder strap naturally.

Riven returns her attention to the road.

The conversation ends, but they remain beside each other.

The allied soldiers continue traveling naturally around them.

The sun moves low behind the distant mountains.

Warm evening light stretches across the valley.

Long shadows cross the dirt road.

Small amounts of dust rise beneath the soldiers' footsteps and catch the golden light.

The camera gradually moves farther away from Riven and Ally Soldier.

Do not make them stop.

Do not make them turn around.

They continue walking naturally.

Gradually reveal more of the mountain valley around them.

The road stretches deep into the landscape.

The military group continues along it.

Riven and Ally Soldier remain walking SIDE BY SIDE within the group.

The camera continues widening until the characters become smaller against the enormous mountain landscape.

The setting sun remains low beyond the distant mountain ridges.

Riven and Ally Soldier continue forward together with the army.

CUT.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Some time has passed since Riven and Ally Soldier began training together.

They are now clearly comfortable around each other.

Ally Soldier is no longer simply someone Riven once saved.

He has become a trusted companion.

Riven has become accustomed to having him beside her.

They can casually joke with each other.

Their relationship remains non-romantic.

Both characters remain healthy and combat-capable.

Riven's large sword remains intact.

They continue serving in the same army.

The scene ends with Riven and Ally Soldier traveling side by side with the military group through the mountain valley.


=== MOOD ===

Warm.

Calm.

Natural.

Familiar.

Cinematic sunset atmosphere.

The scene should feel peaceful after the previous training scenes.

Do not make the interaction sentimental.

Do not make it romantic.

Do not make Ally Soldier behave like an admirer or student.

Do not make Riven behave like a formal instructor.

They should feel like two soldiers who have become genuinely comfortable with each other.

The final image should feel cinematic and peaceful:

Riven and Ally Soldier walking side by side with the army along the mountain road as the sun sets behind the distant mountains.、16:9
